title: Clients, contracts and revenue · local API
notice: DEMO: fictional data only, no authentication. Browser-isolated memory, lost on server restart or after 2 h of inactivity. No database writes. PDFs are drafts not for signing.
localOnly: This API only works on localhost with the development server. Use invented data.
pdfReady: Working PDF downloaded. Legal and linguistic review required.
revenueHelp: USD only. Forecast: unclosed files; realized: commission declared at closing; received: entered receipts. Not sale proceeds, rent or certified accounting.
stepClient: Create a fictional owner, buyer or tenant.
stepProperty: Create the owner’s properties, then publish selected listings.
stepContract: Create a linked mandate or lease and download its bilingual draft.
stepClose: Close the transaction, then record receipts without double counting.
name: Full name / legal name
clientLinksHelp: Buyers or tenants: link one or more properties. New owners: leave existing properties unchecked and create their own properties next.
contractPropertiesHelp: Same owner and transaction type. Up to 10 properties per document. Do not forecast a commission on both mandate and lease: use zero on the lease if already forecast on its mandate.
commissionTerms: Commission: who pays, when and under what conditions?
terms: Specific terms: authority, notice, termination, utilities, repairs, inventory, deposit and disputes as applicable
draftHelp: Free text stays in its input language, without automatic translation. PDFs preserve creation-time information. No signature or legal approval. Leases of 15 years or more excluded.
legalNotice: References: Constitution art. 44; Civil Code arts. 528–530, 596–602, 637–644 and 647 as applicable. Summaries and Khmer translation are not certified; applicable texts, amendments, taxes and formalities require Cambodian legal review.
closingHelp: Irreversible in this demo: property becomes sold or rented. Publication stays unchanged. Realized commission may differ from forecast; one closing per property.
